snippet.title: RHYTHMIC Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 RHYTHMIC - Official Trailer 🔥

RHYTHMIC combines the fast-paced VR rhythm-game genre with tactical tower defense. 

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479170/RHYTHMIC/
Join the community: https://discord.gg/EnEwFn4MEv

Collect magical particles in tune with epic music and skillfully unleash powerful spells upon invading enemies to defend the people whose only hope is your prowess!
VR Rhythm meets Tower Defense!
Music meets Magic!
Beat Saber, but with Magic and Monsters!

All socials: https://linktr.ee/polarrobin


Dieses Video enthält Werbung für mein eigenes Spiel: RHYTHMIC.
